name: Dalal Street Investments Limited
summary: Dalal Street Investments Ltd. functions as a non-banking financial entity primarily engaged in the acquisition and disposition of, as well as holding stakes in, stocks and other financial instruments. The company provides capital to industrial ventures and fosters the development of businesses involved in industrial and commercial activities. Additionally, it oversees diverse collective investment schemes, such as mutual funds, and participates in syndication arrangements for shares and stocks. This firm commenced operations on November 18, 1977, and is based in Mumbai, India.
